active_set_policy: Read exactly the current 64 active IDs from config/brand64-active-brands.json. INACTIVE_LEGACY_REFERENCE brands remain separate.
comparison_policy: Compare the live 2026-08-29 official-source observation against saved 2026-08-28. Historical gaps for 2026-08-22 and 2026-08-26 remain recovered; no unresolved observation gap exists before this run.
offline_policy: Never delete known products when an official page becomes unavailable. Preserve last confirmed fields and mark SOURCE_OFFLINE.
conflict_policy: Do not overwrite fresher baselines with stale/conflicting badges or descriptive-material conflicts. Record the conflict risk until live evidence resolves it.
dedupe_policy: Deduplicate by product_id, official product URL and product code. Never duplicate the same URL/code.
